title: citrus × aurantium subf. ampullacea
intro: Citrus × aurantium subf. ampullacea, commonly known as bitter orange, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, improving digestion, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of bitter orange include stimulating the central nervous system, increasing circulation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, primarily due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins. These compounds contribute to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
